# SpeexDSP 1.2.1

Unmodified echo canceller, residual echo preprocessor, and FFT sources from the
[Xiph.Org 1.2.1 release](https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/speex/speexdsp-1.2.1.tar.gz).
The release archive SHA-256 is `8c777343e4a6399569c72abc38a95b24db56882c83dbdb6c6424a5f4aeb54d3d`.
Local `config.h` uses floating point and the bundled SmallFT implementation.
See [COPYING](COPYING) for the license included with both source and app bundles.
